editorial:
If you enjoy a good underdog story mixed with slapstick action, this French comedy delivers a fun ride. The story follows Johanna, a determined but clumsy woman who dreams of joining the elite RAID police unit. Her family, her future in-laws, and a grumpy veteran officer all doubt her, but she refuses to give up. The humor comes from her awkward attempts to prove herself, and the action scenes keep things lively without taking themselves too seriously. The chemistry between the leads adds warmth, and the pacing rarely slows down.

On the plus side, the movie is packed with laughs, energetic set pieces, and a feel-good message about believing in yourself. On the downside, some jokes feel a bit silly, and the plot follows a familiar formula you have seen before. Still, it is an easy watch that works great for a relaxed movie night. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Johanna finally gets her chance to prove everyone wrong during a real RAID mission. Despite her clumsy reputation, she steps up when it matters most and helps save the day. The veteran officer who doubted her finally shows respect, and her family and in-laws realize she was capable all along. The movie ends on a happy, triumphant note with Johanna officially becoming part of the team, showing that determination can overcome doubt.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted action comedies and underdog stories.
